answer: Like a slow-creeping glacier compacting fresh snowfall into unyielding bedrock, decentralized consensus freezes identity into historical mass. An agent economy resists Sybil clones by charting each entity’s trust into a collective atlas of transitive staking graph depth. Forge a million ghost keys, and their synthetic transactions merely echo against the icy cavern of unvalidated weight. Sublinear influence scaling across graph cuts imposes superlinear attacker cost: saturating quorum thresholds requires compounding real capital, bankrupting counterfeit swarms.
